A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have provided a new perspective on the relation of resolution and tableaux for description logics and we have shown that the resolution proof system can be used to obtain a more compact proof of satisfiability for a knowledge base than the corresponding tableau proof.
we show that resolution proof procedures are more powerful than tableaux proof procedures for ALC.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of reasoning about general knowledge bases, resolution proof systems can be seen as a generalisation of tableaux proof systems.
